text:
Sam: FYI — staging cluster for customer "BlueRiver" is showing 2-3s tail latency spikes on private VPC tests after the image sync was toggled to airgapped mode. Anybody own the NAT/fallback paths? :eyes:
Priya: triage? Which tests fail — image pull or health checks?
Sam: image sync fails: `registry-sync` step times out pulling base images, fallback tries to use egress proxy but NLB isn't routing. Logs show `dial tcp: i/o timeout`. Pasted truncated logs in ticket BR-412.
Jules: I'm on it. Sounds like NLB target group not registering the proxy. @Nate can you confirm NAT gateway routes for staging-blue?
Nate: Looking. Route table for staging-blue had 0/3 healthy NAT targets listed earlier, returning 502 from proxy. Running `aws elbv2 describe-target-health` now.
deploy-bot: Canary for staging-blue image-sync started at 2025-10-03T14:12Z — 0/5 successful.
Priya: If NAT is flakey we should fallback to direct egress to customer VPC for canary, but that needs approvals (security/ops).
Sam: Customer readiness: BlueRiver ops are on stand-by but asked for an ETA. We should avoid a full cutover. Can we do rolling with cached blobs?
Jules: Short term mitigation: enable `registry-sync` cache-only mode (config flag) so pods use cached layers. I'll open a config PR — needs code-review from @Priya and ops sign-off.
Priya: Review pinged: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/PR/987 :eyes:
Nate: Update — I fixed target registration, NAT health is back to 3/3. Suggest we run a smoke with `curl http://proxy.staging.internal/health` first.
Sam: Doing smoke now — proxy health 200 OK. Rerun canary?
deploy-bot: Canary for staging-blue image-sync completed: 3/5 successful, 2 timed out (older errors). Marking partial success.
Sam: Action items: Jules toggle cache-only config (PR 987), Priya approve, Nate confirm NAT remains healthy for next 2 hours, Sam coordinate with BlueRiver ops for staged retry at 16:00 UTC. :calendar: I'll update ticket #BR-412 with timelines.
Priya: Approved PR, added one nit about logging. :thumbsup:
Jules: Merged and deploying config. Tagging ops: @BlueRiverOps please hold for 16:00 UTC retry.
BlueRiverOps: Thanks — standing by. Please notify when you start.
Sam: will post status at T-30 and T+10.
